messages:
ellie-partnerships: Quick heads up 4 CloudForge wants Redwood listed in GCP Marketplace for their sovereign eu-central-2 nodepool. They need billing SKU mapping, KMS attestation, and preview invoice for marketplace approval. Pilot target: 10 business days. Any red flags?

tom-cloud: Filed ticket MKT-9942 for GCP quota + listing. I attached sku_map.csv and sample_invoice.pdf. GCP asked for KMS ownership proof.

ravi-security: We'll need HSM vendor attestation and an architecture diagram showing CMK in-region. Also confirm audit logs never egress.

nora-ops: Ops items: subnet ranges, PSC support, and a failover playbook. I'll draft the playbook skeleton in ops repo and add canary steps.

sales-kevin: Sales OK. CloudForge requests 4x A2 + 1x H100 for pilot and wants discount tiers for committed capacity.

ops-bot: [quota-bot] MKT-9942 status: AWAITING_GCP_REVIEW. Attachments present.

ellie-partnerships: Action list: tom -> follow up on GCP KMS requirement; ravi -> request HSM attestation; nora -> ops playbook; kevin -> draft partner addendum with discount lanes. Deadlines 48h.

tom-cloud: Follow-up done, GCP replied: please upload key usage policy and KMS diagram to the ticket.

ravi-security: Pinged vendor for attestation; asked for SOC2/HSM whitepaper.

nora-ops: Playbook started: https://git.redwood/ops/region-playbooks/euc2. Added fallback mapping to A2 pool if H100 unavailable. PR coming.

ellie-partnerships: Great. If GCP approves quotas this week and attestation arrives, we'll lock pilot kickoff on Monday. Will update here. :rocket:
